harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s bin/unpack. It now fully preflights archives, rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, symlinks and other non-file members before installation, and safely accepts ordinary nested files. Source packages and protected data were preserved. The fix persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced the unsafe direct extraction with copy, complete member validation, staged extraction, and installation into incoming/.
Used only existing RHEL 10 software: Python 3.12 standard library, GNU tar and coreutils; no packages or OS components were changed.
Retained the original script as root-only bin/.unpack.before-member-safety.
Tested every supplied normal and malformed archive before and after reboot.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed from 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146 to 8125891a-45c7-42cf-a6ea-2bdcc8009ac1.

evidence.requirement: Ordinary nested files are accepted into incoming/
evidence.summary: normal.tar installed docs/notice.txt with byte-for-byte matching content before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Absolute paths are rejected before installing members
evidence.summary: absolute.tar returned 2 and incoming remained unchanged; outside.txt was absent.

evidence.requirement: Parent traversal is rejected before installing any members
evidence.summary: traversal.tar returned 2, incoming remained unchanged, and its preceding accepted.txt member was not installed.

evidence.requirement: Symlink-based escapes are rejected before installing members
evidence.summary: symlink.tar returned 2, incoming remained unchanged, and no escape symlink was created.

evidence.requirement: Supplier packages and protected sibling data are preserved
evidence.summary: All four package SHA-256 hashes and protected/customer.txt hash match the initial baseline after testing and restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release, kernel and security controls remain intact
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained installed; SELinux stayed Enforcing and sshd/chronyd recovered active.

Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running system, recovered services, persisted files and hashes, post-restart allow/deny workflow, listener recovery, and absence of staging residue.
